description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Strategic Development Project Act, No. 14 of 2008, Notification Under Section 3(2)
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008 and provides specific regulatory exemptions (tax exemptions, VAT exemptions, customs duty exemptions) for a designated strategic development project. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework modifications and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
